title: Billing Office Determination: Storage Charge Amount for Ridgeline Special Order Services Items
content:
**Determination.** The storage charge on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent counts the calendar days from the ready date to the completed date (to today while the item is still at the store), less the program's free hold days, never below zero, and charges the program's storage fee per day for each of those days, rounded to the nearest cent and never more than the program's storage fee cap, as one storage fee line. The storage fee line records those days as its days of storage billed. An order linked to an installation contract, or in a program whose storage fee per day is 0.00, carries no storage charge.

## Terms used

- **The ready date** is the date the item became ready for pickup or delivery; **the completed date** is the date of pickup or delivery.
- **The free hold** is the program's free hold, in days after the ready date.
- The program's storage fee per day, free hold and storage fee cap are the figures of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services receiving, hold and storage schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders)

| Program figures | Ready date | Completed date | Days at store | Storage days | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| free hold 30, 5.00 a day, cap 150.00 | 1 March | 15 April | 45 | 15 | 75.00 |
| free hold 30, 10.00 a day, cap 300.00 | 1 March | 30 May | 90 | 60 | 600.00 held to 300.00 |
| free hold 30, 10.00 a day, cap 300.00 | 1 March | 21 March | 20 | 0 | 0.00 |

## Basis questions

**Which day ends the count while the item is still at the store?** Today.

**Is the cap applied before or after rounding?** The charge is rounded to the nearest cent and then held to no more than the cap.
